description: Have Buddy bring a notification into this chat whenever one matching arrives, with an instruction: "when Sam writes on WhatsApp, answer that I'm driving". Buddy shows the user the rule on a card and adds it only if they approve. Each match then comes here as a new message to you, quoting the notification, and you work as a notification rule's run does: phone tools with cards before anything risky, no shell, files or web, Trust doesn't apply. The rule starts on asking before acting; the user changes or deletes it in Settings > Safety and approvals > Notification rules. For a time instead of a notification, use schedule_message.

app.description: The app the notification comes from: its name or package

from.description: Optional: only from these senders or chats, comma-separated

instruction.description: What to do when it comes, as a message to yourself

words.description: Optional: only notifications with one of these words, comma-separated

name: add_notification_rule
